summary: The figure shows the main barriers to implementation of national health and climate change plans or strategies in 2021, measured by the percentage of countries reporting each barrier. The most common barrier is insufficient finance/budget at 70%, followed by insufficient human resource capacity (54%) and constraints related to COVID-19 (52%). The least common barriers are lack of endorsement by Ministry of Health and other reasons, both at 7%.
